title: Harrisburg East Campground and Storage

services.name: Campground & Storage
services.desc: Click here for directions from your area to the campground. The following paragraph will help as you approach the property: Approach from Eisenhower Boulevard onto Campground Road. Travel to the top of the hill and stop at the intersection of Campground Rd. and Highspire Rd. then drive straight across Highspire Rd.

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Harrisburg East welcomes you! Enjoy all that South Central Pennsylvania has to offer from the state capital. Open all year, we are a great place to take a break from your travels. We are minutes off the beltway, so you’ll be easily back on the road in the morning. Come to explore all the amusements and events and relax in our pool at the end of your day.
